content_provenance: Original bilingual paraphrase of Apache documentation; operator preconditions are Shapoclyack runbook guidance, not vendor requirements.

summary.en: Apache 2.4 supports TraceEnable in server or virtual-host configuration. Setting it to off rejects TRACE with 405. The vendor distinguishes this policy choice from a vulnerability in Apache.
summary.ru: Apache 2.4 поддерживает TraceEnable в конфигурации сервера или виртуального хоста. Значение off отклоняет TRACE с кодом 405. Поставщик отличает это решение политики от уязвимости Apache.

operator_preconditions: Independently confirm the running Apache 2.4 process and the owning server or virtual host; a remote banner is insufficient.
Back up the active configuration and record the previous setting before an approved change.
Validate configuration and reload through the existing administrator runbook; the operator does not execute the change.
Verify using the same approved TRACE detector with successful HTTP reachability and complete matching plugin coverage.
Rollback restores the recorded configuration through the approved change procedure; re-enabling TRACE may restore the policy deviation.
